# Collated string search and replacement:
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/string_functions.md
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/collation-concepts.md
# Case-insensitive examples from GoogleSQL's compliance/functions_testlib_string_5.cc,
# GetFunctionTestsStringWithCollatorInitializerList and GetReplaceFunctions.

SELECT STARTS_WITH(COLLATE('starts!_with', 'und:ci'), 'sTaRts!')
=> "true"

SELECT STARTS_WITH('StArTs_WiTh', COLLATE('sTarTs_wItH', 'und:ci'))
=> "true"

SELECT STARTS_WITH(COLLATE('starts_with', 'und:ci'), 'with')
=> "false"

SELECT STARTS_WITH(COLLATE('абвгд', 'und:ci'), 'аБв')
=> "true"

SELECT ENDS_WITH(COLLATE('ends_with', 'und:ci'), 'WItH')
=> "true"

SELECT ENDS_WITH('ends_wITh', COLLATE('WitH', 'und:ci'))
=> "true"

SELECT ENDS_WITH(COLLATE('ends_with', 'und:ci'), 'ends')
=> "false"

SELECT ENDS_WITH(COLLATE('абвгд', 'und:ci'), 'вгД')
=> "true"

SELECT STRPOS(COLLATE('AaA', 'und:ci'), 'a')
=> "1"

SELECT STRPOS('AbAbA', COLLATE('Ba', 'und:ci'))
=> "2"

SELECT INSTR(COLLATE('AaA', 'und:ci'), 'a')
=> "1"

SELECT INSTR('AaA', COLLATE('a', 'und:ci'), 2)
=> "2"

SELECT INSTR(COLLATE('AbAbA', 'und:ci'), 'Ba', 1, 2)
=> "4"

SELECT INSTR(COLLATE('AbAbA', 'und:ci'), 'Ba', -1)
=> "4"

SELECT INSTR(COLLATE('AbAbA', 'und:ci'), 'Ba', -1, 2)
=> "2"

SELECT REPLACE(COLLATE('ABC', 'und:ci'), 'b', 'xyz')
=> "AxyzC"

SELECT REPLACE('ABCaBC', COLLATE('bC', 'und:ci'), 'xyz')
=> "Axyzaxyz"

SELECT REPLACE(COLLATE('BaNaNA', 'und:ci'), 'AnA', 'xYz')
=> "BxYzNA"

SELECT REPLACE(COLLATE('bäNäÑä', 'und:ci'), 'n', 'ä')
=> "bäääÑä"

SELECT REPLACE(COLLATE('AbC', 'und:ci'), '', 'xyz')
=> "AbC"

SELECT SPLIT(COLLATE('banAna', 'und:ci'), 'a')
=> [{"v":"b"},{"v":"n"},{"v":"n"},{"v":""}]

SELECT SPLIT('banAnA', COLLATE('aN', 'und:ci'))
=> [{"v":"b"},{"v":""},{"v":"A"}]

SELECT SPLIT(COLLATE('a,b', 'und:ci'))
=> [{"v":"a"},{"v":"b"}]

SELECT SPLIT(COLLATE('whät', 'und:ci'), '')
=> [{"v":"w"},{"v":"h"},{"v":"ä"},{"v":"t"}]

# NULL propagation, including optional arguments and the replacement (which does not choose
# the operation's collation).
SELECT STARTS_WITH(COLLATE(NULL, 'und:ci'), 'a')
=> null

SELECT ENDS_WITH(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), NULL)
=> null

SELECT STRPOS(COLLATE(NULL, 'und:ci'), 'a')
=> null

SELECT INSTR(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), 'a', NULL)
=> null

SELECT INSTR(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), 'a', 1, NULL)
=> null

SELECT REPLACE(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), 'a', NULL)
=> null

SELECT SPLIT(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), NULL) IS NULL
=> "true"

# INSTR rejects zero position and nonpositive occurrence, including with SAFE.
SELECT SAFE.INSTR(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), 'b', 0)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.INSTR(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), 'b', 1, 0)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.INSTR(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), 'b', 1, -1)
=> null

SELECT INSTR(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), 'b', 0)
=> error:

SELECT INSTR(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), 'b', 1, 0)
=> error:

# Conditional expressions must still short-circuit a failing collated call.
SELECT IF(FALSE, INSTR(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), 'b', 0), 7)
=> "7"

# Removing collation selects the ordinary case-sensitive implementation.
SELECT STARTS_WITH(COLLATE(COLLATE('ABC', 'und:ci'), ''), 'a')
=> "false"

SELECT SPLIT(COLLATE(COLLATE('banAna', 'und:ci'), ''), 'a')
=> [{"v":"b"},{"v":"nAn"},{"v":""}]

# BigQuery's recorded answers: empty and ignorable-only search terms do not match under
# und:ci, unlike binary search. Replacement and splitting preserve unmatched text.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(
  STARTS_WITH(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), '') AS starts,
  ENDS_WITH(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), '') AS ends,
  STRPOS(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), '') AS strpos,
  INSTR(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), '') AS instr))
=> "{\"starts\":false,\"ends\":false,\"strpos\":0,\"instr\":0}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(
  STARTS_WITH(COLLATE('', 'und:ci'), '') AS starts,
  ENDS_WITH(COLLATE('', 'und:ci'), '') AS ends,
  STRPOS(COLLATE('', 'und:ci'), '') AS strpos,
  INSTR(COLLATE('', 'und:ci'), '', -1) AS instr))
=> "{\"starts\":false,\"ends\":false,\"strpos\":0,\"instr\":0}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(
  STARTS_WITH(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), '\u0000') AS starts,
  ENDS_WITH(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), '\u0000') AS ends,
  STRPOS(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), '\u0000') AS strpos,
  REPLACE(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), '\u0000', 'X') AS replaced,
  SPLIT(COLLATE('abc', 'und:ci'), '\u0000') AS split))
=> "{\"starts\":false,\"ends\":false,\"strpos\":0,\"replaced\":\"abc\",\"split\":[\"abc\"]}"

# Canonically equivalent strings match, with positions in original Unicode code points,
# including a supplementary character before the match.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(
  STARTS_WITH(COLLATE('a\u030ax', 'und:ci'), 'Å') AS starts,
  ENDS_WITH(COLLATE('xa\u030a', 'und:ci'), 'Å') AS ends,
  STRPOS(COLLATE('😀a\u030ax', 'und:ci'), 'Å') AS strpos,
  INSTR(COLLATE('😀a\u030axÅ', 'und:ci'), 'Å', -1, 2) AS instr,
  REPLACE(COLLATE('😀a\u030axÅ', 'und:ci'), 'Å', '!') AS replaced,
  SPLIT(COLLATE('😀a\u030axÅ', 'und:ci'), 'Å') AS split))
=> "{\"starts\":true,\"ends\":true,\"strpos\":2,\"instr\":2,\"replaced\":\"😀!x!\",\"split\":[\"😀\",\"x\",\"\"]}"

# Propagation is determined by resolver annotations, separately from the search collation.
SELECT REPLACE('abc', 'b', COLLATE('X', 'und:ci')) = 'AXC'
=> "true"

SELECT SPLIT(COLLATE('a,B', 'und:ci'))[OFFSET(1)] = 'b'
=> "true"
